query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_audits,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qcApproved=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as qc_passed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qcApproved=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as qc_failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wasRecomposed=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as recomposed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN messageSent=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sent,
  SUM(CASE WHEN blocked=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as blocked
FROM brain_council_audit 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH);
